normalized.result: Yes, that's the predictable fallback I wanted — and it answers the small worry I flagged when we first did formatted notes. The lone `*` in "2 * 3" stayed as a plain asterisk, and the unmatched `**` in front of "unfinished thought" showed up literally instead of secretly turning the rest of my note bold. So the formatting only kicks in when I clearly mean it, and a stray symbol just shows as I typed it. That's exactly the safe, no-surprises behavior I was hoping for. Good.
